headline: Vietnam Airlines TPHCM-Phuket strategic expansion
summary: Vietnam Airlines công bố đường bay thẳng TPHCM - Phuket, mở rộng hợp tác chiến lược tại Thái Lan. Strategic international route expansion, positive for aviation sector.
analysis: Direct HVN exposure to TPHCM-Phuket route expansion confirms strategic growth. Country-level event affects aviation/securities cascade. Market-wide inflation from 8/10 neutral→7/10 chain impact. Confidence 73% based on official announcement.
